answer: For voyage planners serving a jetty, an agent market can allocate work through a lottery over reserved bonds. Each locked unit gets one ticket; delegating it to extra keys cannot echo that ticket into additional entries. The ledger freezes the allocation before revealing the lottery seed and keeps selected bonds reserved until delivery, preventing reuse across overlapping jobs. A Sybil operator must lock more capital to win more slots, paying its opportunity cost. This removes the benefit of extra identities, provided there are no per-key bonuses or minimum allocations.
